title: Toward Personal Intelligence Through Cooperative Observation
abstract: arXiv:2608.17128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A personal AI system needs a model of the user's goals, constraints, and ongoing commitments to plan and act on their behalf, and the quality of that model is bounded by what the system can observe. Broader observation does not by itself improve assistance because a bounded system must select and compress information for the task at hand. We argue that this observation bottleneck has a cooperative structure: the system builds a partial model of the user's changing life, the user evaluates its actions, and the user's consent and control shape what it can observe next. Useful and inspectable behavior can give users a reason to maintain or expand the observation channel, while failures can lead them to correct, narrow, revoke, or abandon it. We use the term cooperative observation for this feedback loop among usefulness, trust, and future access, and propose it as a framework for personal intelligence. translated_title: 迈向通过协作观察实现的个人智能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17128v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：个人AI系统需要用户目标、约束和持续承诺的模型，以便代表用户规划和行动，而该模型的质量受限于系统能观察到什么。更广泛的观察本身并不会提升辅助能力，因为一个有限系统必须为当前任务选择和压缩信息。我们认为这种观察瓶颈具有协作结构：系统构建用户变化生活的部分模型，用户评估其行动，用户的同意和控制塑造了系统接下来能观察到的内容。有用且可检查的行为可以给用户理由维持或扩大观察通道，而失败可能导致用户纠正、缩小、撤销或放弃它。我们将这种有用性、信任和未来访问之间的反馈循环称为协作观察，并提出将其作为个人智能的框架。我们报告了一项初步的单受试者研究。
tldr: 本文提出“协作观察”框架，强调个人AI系统通过有用性和信任的反馈循环，在用户控制下优化观察范围，以提升个人智能的辅助效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "cooperative observation" framework, emphasizing that personal AI systems optimize observation scope under user control through a feedback loop of usefulness and trust to enhance personal intelligence assistance.
